title: Developer Automation Testing
description:
**Job Details:**

The Quality Engineers II have solid knowledge and expertise in quality assurance and quality control processes. They are responsible for designing and implementing quality control measures, conducting advanced testing and analysis, and driving continuous improvement in product quality. Quality Engineers II also collaborate with cross\-functional teams to establish quality standards, resolve complex quality issues, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: • Delivers medium\-high complexity testing tasks as part of a team. Influences in collaborative meetings with peers and stakeholders. Interacts with stakeholders to create requirements and demonstrate work. Documents testing and outcomes. Follows established software product engineering practices related to testing. Scope: Enterprise. • Works under moderate supervision with access to assistance for work assignments not covered through established guidelines. • Acquires solid knowledge and develops specialized skills. • Establishes individual priorities when supporting projects and/or processes. • Perform other assigned job\-related duties that align with our organization's vision, mission, and values and fall within your scope of practice. Test Planning and Strategy: • Developing and implementing test plans, cases, and scripts based on software requirements and specifications. • Defining the scope and objectives of testing, including the identification of test resources and tools. Manual and Automated Testing: • Performing manual testing to identify defects and ensure software functionality. • Developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, JUnit, or TestNG. Defect Management: • Identifying, documenting, and tracking software defects using defect tracking tools like Gitlab or ALM. • Collaborating with developers to reproduce issues, provide detailed defect reports, and verify fixes. Performance and Load Testing: • Conducting performance, load, and stress testing to ensure software scalability and reliability. • Analyzing performance test results and identifying bottlenecks or performance issues. Continuous Integration and Deployment (CI/CD): • Integrating automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing and rapid feedback. • Monitoring and maintaining the CI/CD environment to ensure smooth and efficient software delivery. Quality Metrics and Reporting: • Collecting and analyzing quality metrics to assess software quality and testing effectiveness. • Prepare and present test reports and quality metrics to stakeholders and management. Test Environment Management: • Setting up and maintaining test environments, including hardware, software, and network configurations. • Ensuring test environments are representative of production environments. Compliance and Standards: • Ensuring software testing processes comply with industry standards and best practices. • Keeping up to date with changes in software testing methodologies and tools. Collaboration and Communication: • Working closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and provide feedback. • Participating in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.


**Job Overview:**
-----------------


We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Engineer to join the **FGA DevEx** team and lead the evolution of our end to end developer experience across both OSS and SaaS.


This team owns the SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and other languages, along with CLI workflows, IDE integrations, GitHub automation, developer documentation, and release strategy. All development is done in the open as open source, and we actively welcome and review community contributions.


Our guiding principle is One developer experience, many deployment models.


As a Staff Engineer, you will define technical direction, ensure cross language consistency, influence API design in partnership with FGA Core, and raise the quality bar across all developer facing tooling.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Define and drive the technical direction for **FGA DevEx** , CLI, IDE integrations, and developer automation across OSS and SaaS.
* Lead architectural decisions for multi language SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, and Java, leveraging and evolving the SDK generator that forms the core of all clients.
* Own and evolve the SDK generator framework, templates, and wrapper patterns to ensure cross language consistency, configurability, and long term maintainability.
* Establish standards across SDKs for authentication flows such as client credentials, error mapping and handling, retry logic with appropriate rate limiting strategies, and method level configuration overrides.
* Ensure advanced SDK capabilities such as BatchCheck, ListRelations, and non transactional write operations are implemented with appropriate parallelization, performance safeguards, and consistency across languages.
* Own and evolve the release and versioning strategy for SDKs and developer tooling.
* Drive improvements to CLI workflows, GitHub Actions, CI pipelines, and developer focused documentation and examples.
* Ensure high engineering standards for testing, mocking external requests, dependency management, performance, and minimal external dependencies.
* Lead development fully in open source, review community pull requests, guide contributors to a mergeable state, and improve contribution workflows and community health.
* Partner closely with FGA Core on API design and semantics, and with internal consumers such as Dashboard to ensure developer friendly interfaces.
* Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the Developer Tooling team.

**Requirements:**
-----------------


* 8\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience building SDKs, developer platforms, or tooling.
* Proficiency in at least one, and ideally multiple, of the following: Go, JavaScript or TypeScript, C\# .NET, Python, or Java.
* Strong understanding of SDK design principles, API ergonomics, and cross language consistency.
* Experience designing or maintaining code generation systems such as OpenAPI Generator and templating frameworks.
* Experience designing authentication flows, retry strategies, rate limiting, and resilient client side systems.
* Experience setting up and maintaining GitHub Actions and release workflows.
* Strong testing practices including mocking external services and validating client behavior.
* Experience working in open source projects and PR based contribution models. Experience maintaining or leading open source projects is strongly preferred.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams and operate effectively in a distributed, open development environment.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with internal teams and external contributors.

The solutions heavily leverage technology to challenge conventional wisdom with hard data. Our SDEs solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first\-hand.  

In this role you will have the opportunity to exercise your creativity and explore ideas to simulate and quantify any aspect of the customer experience.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions for data collection and analysis platforms
* Build and optimize automated data collection frameworks across different surfaces (web, mobile)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and implement efficient solutions
* Write high\-quality, maintainable code while following best practices and design patterns
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation
* Debug production issues and implement performance improvements
* Work with ML technologies and LLM driven extraction services to enhance data processing capabilities
* Contribute to architecture decisions and technical strategy
* Mentor junior developers and participate in team's agile development process

  

A day in the life  

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other engineers to build tools that enable large\-scale data collection and analysis. You'll tackle challenges ranging from Automated Data Collection framework development to building new features for our self\-service tools, while ensuring high performance and reliability.  

  

About the team  

Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT) is an organization made up of a diverse suite of functions dedicated to deeply understanding and improving customer experience, globally. We are a team of builders that develop products, services, ideas, and various ways of leveraging data to influence product and service offerings – for almost every business at Amazon – for every customer (e.g., consumers, developers, sellers/brands, employees, investors, streamers, gamers).  

  

Our approach is based on determining the customer need, along with problem solving, and we work backwards from there. We use technical and non\-technical approaches and stay aware of industry and business trends. We are a global team, made up of a diverse set of profiles, skills, and backgrounds – including: Product Managers, Software Developers, Computer Vision experts, Solutions Architects, Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Business Analysts, Risk Managers, and more.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques

* High accountability and ownership, with strong self\-management, prioritization, and the ability to meet deadlines.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365 \- all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.85B\+ from the world’s top investors \- including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

 *We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @rippling.com addresses.*

**About the HRIS Product Team at Rippling:**
--------------------------------------------


Rippling is rapidly expanding its customer base, supporting larger enterprise customers, and launching new lines of business across its 20\+ products, all while scaling globally. At the hear of this ecosystem is Employee Records, a foundational element that powers not only HR products but also integrates seamlessly with every product to deliver a unified, cohesive experience.


The HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) team plays a critical role in managing all aspects of employee data, including hiring, onboarding, offboarding, and transitions. The team's mission is to ensure the correctness and completeness of employee records, which serve as the backbone of Rippling’s ecosystem.


HRIS operates at the forefront of Rippling’s growth, building new products at high velocity to support expansion into new verticals and customer segments while maintaining the integrity of data. As the entry point for any new customer or product integration, the HRIS team is pivotal to delivering Rippling’s vision of a unified platform for modern workforce management.

**HRIS Product Verticals**

**HRIS Flows Experience**: Focused on creating simple, intuitive workflows that empower Rippling's customers to manage employee data seamlessly.

**HRIS Flows Infrastructure:** Provides the scalable backbone for all flow products, prioritizing reliability, data integrity, and performance at scale.

**HR Applications:** Develops essential tools and interfaces for customers to view, manage, and interact with employee data effectively.

**Org Management**: Enables the creation and maintenance of company structures tailored to organizations of all sizes and complexities.

  

We are seeking a visionary and hands\-on Staff Engineers to join our Rippling HRIS team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in building internet\-scale distributed systems, developing scalable services, and crafting clean, modular APIs. This role requires deep expertise in both analytical and transactional systems, and a strong understanding of Scalability , Concurrency , SLAs, system resiliency, and observability. The candidate should be proficient in coding with languages such as Python, Golang, and Java, and experienced in handling systems with millions of users.


Key Responsibilities

* Architect and Lead: Design, develop, and maintain internet\-scale, highly distributed systems and scalable services for the Rippling HRIS team.
* Hands\-On Coding: Actively participate in coding and code reviews, using languages such as Python, Golang, and Java.
* Technical Leadership: Provide visionary technical leadership, setting the direction for engineering best practices and the adoption of advanced technologies.
* Mentorship: Mentor and support engineers across the organization, fostering a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.
* System Design: Architect systems capable of handling millions of users simultaneously, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
* API Development: Design and implement clean, modularized abstraction APIs and programmatic APIs for both end users and engineers, including Backend for Frontend (BFF) systems.
* Storage Solutions: Design and implement Analytical systems that encompass both analytical (e.g., Presto, S3, Snowflake) and transactional (e.g., MySQL, Aurora, MongoDB) systems. They should be able to handle petabyte scale
* Resiliency and SLAs: Develop and maintain systems with high availability and reliability, targeting four or five 9s (99\.99% or 99\.999%) uptime.
* Observability: Implement comprehensive observability practices, including monitoring, logging, and tracing, to ensure system health and performance.
* Streaming and Workflow Systems: Build and integrate streaming solutions (e.g., Spark Streaming, Apache Flink, Kafka Connect) and workflow systems for both transactional and analytical workflows.
* Collaboration: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product management, data science, and operations, to align on strategic goals and ensure successful project delivery.
* Innovation: Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, driving innovation and continuous improvement within the Rippling HRIS team.
* Documentation and Standards: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards for system architecture, design, and operational processes.

**What success looks like**

* **Org\-level leverage**: Product teams ship faster without re\-implementing common patterns or unintentionally breaking critical paths.
* **Performance \& reliability**: App Shell consistently meets defined SLAs for performance and reliability, with regressions caught automatically.
* **Consistency at scale**: Core UI behaviors (grids, editor, navigation, flows) behave predictably across the product.
* **Platform adoption**: New and existing teams adopt UI Platform services as defaults rather than building bespoke solutions.
* **Technical leadership**: Engineers across the org look to you for architectural guidance and platform direction.

 **What We’re Looking For**

* 15\+ years of experience building and operating large\-scale backend, distributed, or platform systems.
* Deep programming experience in one or more backend languages such as **Golang, Java, or Python**.
* Strong fundamentals in backend architecture, including API design, data modelling, service boundaries, dependency management, concurrency, performance, reliability, and failure isolation.
* Proven experience building internal platforms or foundational systems used by multiple engineering teams.
* Experience designing guardrails, validation systems, and automated enforcement mechanisms—not just publishing guidelines.
* Strong operational ownership, including observability, debugging, incident response, capacity planning, and production reliability.
* Experience leading complex architectural initiatives and large\-scale migrations across multiple teams.
* Ability to influence engineering direction without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Comfortable balancing hands\-on coding and technical execution with architecture, mentorship, and organizational leadership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly through design documents, RFCs, architecture reviews, and cross\-team alignment.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience building configuration\-driven platforms, workflow engines, orchestration systems, developer platforms, or low\-code frameworks.
* Experience owning foundational platform systems adopted by hundreds of engineers or multiple product organizations.
* Background in safely migrating thousands of existing configurations, workflows, or application instances onto new platforms.
* Experience establishing performance budgets, reliability guardrails, platform governance, and automated architectural enforcement.
* Practical experience using AI\-assisted developer tooling to accelerate migrations, automate refactoring, validate invariants, or review large\-scale system changes.
* Familiarity with web or mobile application architecture and the backend infrastructure required to support complex user\-facing platforms.

description:
In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in Application\-Specific Integrated Circuit/System on a chip (ASIC/SoC) development with Verilog/SystemVerilog.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python, C/C\+\+ or Perl).

* Knowledge of arithmetic units, processor design, accelerators, bus architectures, fabrics/NoC or memory hierarchies.

**About the job**
-----------------


In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting\-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML\-driven systems.

In this role, you will be part of a team developing SoCs used to accelerate Machine Learning (ML) computation in data centers. You will solve technical problems with innovative and practical logic solutions, and evaluate design options with complexity, performance, power and area in mind. You will collaborate with members of architecture, verification, power and performance, physical design etc., to specify and deliver high quality designs for next generation data center accelerators.

  

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own microarchitecture and implementation of complex IPs and subsystems.
* Take ownership of RTL implementation and quality checks of one or more modules.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

AIS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Software Development Engineer who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Software and Application. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain \& Procurement. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud with high security bar.  

These are all greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up. You will be part of a Supply Chain Automation team within AWS building large scale distributed applications, designing and developing systems from scratch utilizing technologies and frameworks like reactive micro services, serverless computing and distributed NoSQL data stores.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Solve complex architecture and business problems to come up with extensible solutions.
* Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business\-friendly software solutions.
* Design client\-side and server\-side architecture for Supply Chain applications.
* Write high quality code that is modular, functional and testable.
* Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support Supply Chain platforms.
* Write effective APIs and develop technical specifications and documentation.
* Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency; troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
* Formally mentor junior engineers on design, coding and troubleshooting.
* Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 3\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Experience communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs
* Experience with Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development is a plus

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Strong DevOps and SDLC practices, including code reviews, test automation, secure coding practices, and operational ownership.
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for services and platform components, including GitHub Actions.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills; comfortable working with cost and usage datasets to spot trends and drive practical engineering changes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to partner eMectively across platform, application, and operations teams to drive changes through to production




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience with Kubernetes and cloud cost visibility and optimization tools such as Kubecost, AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Budgets, AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), AWS Compute Optimizer, and CloudWatch.

Strong communication, problem\-solving, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to operate successfully in fast\-paced and dynamic project environments.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**About Starburst**
-------------------



Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock\-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai.

#### **About the Team**



We build the AI layer for Starburst's products, including AIDA. We design agents that let users ask questions in natural language and get accurate, grounded answers backed by their actual data. We operate with startup speed inside an enterprise company, shipping weekly and measuring results. This is the first dedicated platform engineering hire on the team.


#### **Role Summary**



You will build the shared development primitives that make multiple product teams faster, with clean abstractions across the Python/JVM boundary. This role is a force multiplier: instead of building product features directly, you build the platform, SDK, and tooling that enables every other engineer on the team to ship faster.



You will own the developer experience for agent development at Starburst, building from 0 to 1 and scaling across teams. Your work is measured by other engineers' velocity, not your own feature output.


#### **As an AI Platform Engineer at Starburst, you will:**


* Design and build an agent development SDK that abstracts common patterns (tool registration, context management, evaluation hooks, prompt management)
* Build the language bridge between Python (AI ecosystem) and JVM (Starburst platform) with type safety, error propagation, and observability across the boundary
* Create developer tooling: local development environments, debugging tools, test harnesses, CI integration
* Define and maintain API contracts between the AI layer and the Starburst platform
* Build shared infrastructure: model gateway, observability pipeline, experiment framework
* Develop unified, product\-agnostic components used across multiple products
* Own platform health beyond feature delivery: performance, reliability, developer ergonomics

#### **Some of the things that we look for:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling
* Proficiency in both Python and JVM languages (Java or Kotlin)
* Experience designing APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams
* Strong distributed systems fundamentals: RPC, serialization, error handling, observability
* Experience with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
* Track record of building tools that measurably improve other engineers' velocity

#### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with LLM integration patterns: model APIs, token management, streaming, tool use
* Experience with cross\-language interop (gRPC, FFI, language bridges)
* Open\-source contributions to developer tooling or infrastructure projects
* Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and experiment infrastructure
* Experience supporting both research and production workloads on the same platform
* Java agent framework experience (LangChain4j)
* **Ability to Travel**: This role will require 25% in\-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs.

**Build your career at Starburst**
----------------------------------



All\-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we're empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry\-proven technology and unprecedented success, All\-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry – and the future.



Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.



We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All\-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All\-Stars to show up authentically.

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer - NV Cloud Functions
description:
Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA Cloud Functions (NVCF) is an open\-source platform that links workloads to GPUs. It lets teams deploy, manage, and serve GPU\-accelerated, containerized applications across regions and clusters worldwide. The platform routes inference, streaming, and batch jobs across decentralized GPU clusters. This allows endpoints to scale repeatably, whether hosted on\-prem or in the cloud.


We are seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to join our team. You will focus on improving the performance, reliability, and scaling behavior of a system that routes AI workloads onto distributed GPU fleets. You will work on a polyglot platform that is now fully open source, with both control plane and edge deployments. The work suits someone with deep experience in systems performance, distributed systems, and Kubernetes\-based runtimes. We are looking for engineers who want to learn and grow. Expect to be challenged in an environment with rapidly shifting priorities, where insight, focus, and execution are key.

**What you will be doing:**

* You'll be working in a distributed team that explores innovative ways to make GPU\- and DPU\-accelerated applications easier to develop, deploy, and monitor on the latest and greatest NVIDIA hardware.
* Design and ship services in Java, Go, and Rust, building in the open on a public repository where your commits, design proposals, and reviews are transparent to the community.
* Work on automating and optimizing build, test, integration, and release processes for cloud native.
* Partner with engineering teams across NVIDIA so the platform integrates with adjacent NVIDIA technologies, including the KAI Scheduler, NVIDIA NIM, Grove, and Dynamo.
* Help steward an open\-source project. You will triage community issues and pull requests and write docs contributors can build on.

**What we need to see:**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 3\+ years of hands\-on software engineering.
* Expert\-level knowledge in a systems programming language (Go, C, Rust) and a proven understanding of Data Structures, Algorithms, and Distributed Software Architecture
* Strong understanding of container orchestration systems (Kubernetes) and container technologies with hands\-on automation experience in continuous integration frameworks like GitLab \& ArgoCD.
* Expertise in a scripting language (Bash, Python) and knowledge and experience working with the system internals of Unix/Unix\-like kernels such as Linux.
* Understanding of performance, security, and reliability in complex distributed systems.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**
-------------------------------------

* Background with pub\-sub models and message queues
* Experience optimizing for high\-throughput network paths, with a working understanding of unary versus streaming and bidirectional protocols across HTTP/2 and gRPC.
* Experience with developing Kubernetes Custom Resources and Operators deployed in Cloud Service Providers


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward\-thinking and hardworking individuals in the industry working for us. Due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are expanding rapidly. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**A.P. Moller \- Maersk**

A.P. Moller – Maersk is the global leader in container shipping services. The business operates in 130 countries and employs c. 80,000 staff. An integrated container logistics company, Maersk aims to connect and simplify its customers’ supply chains.


**We Offer**

Joining Maersk will embark you on a transformational journey with great opportunities for career development within a global organization. As a Senior OSS Engineer, you will design, engineer and run our capabilities for the Operational Support Systems (OSS) and Tools stack for network and perimeter products and platforms that enable highly distributed global business for site, fleet, asset and IoT connectivity, required to deliver against our strategy. You will be exposed to a wide and challenging range of needs and opportunities requiring you to engage closely with stakeholders across all levels within Maersk as you mature and evolve our OSS capabilities for Network OSS to become world class.


**The Brief**

A globally focused shipping and transportation organisation is continuing to drive an ambitious and complex change and transformational programme to deliver a service of excellence for its customers and clients worldwide. The Global CTIO has a mandate from the Maersk board to lead the Technology transformation of Maersk which will enable the Maersk business strategy to become the global integrator of container logistics through digitising the Maersk business processes and customer engagement.


The Technology Function is fundamental to enable the company’s transformation and in response to this demand, our in\-house technological capability is growing exponentially. We are recruiting world class talent to ensure that the technology services are modernised to enable Maersk to become a logistics integrator leveraging a competitive advantage through technology.


**Why this job matters?** 

The Network OSS Engineering function is essential to our transformation, it is a central team within Network Architecture \& Engineering, responsible for the delivery of product roadmaps, technical vision and quality across Fulfilment and Assurance that underpin our network and perimeter capabilities and products.


Reporting to the Senior OSS Engineering Manager you will serve as a Senior OSS Engineer, ensuring that our systems and tools for the network OSS realise business value. Your role is responsible for technical design and delivery of solutions across the network OSS applications landscape from monitoring to analytics driven AIOps. All built to industry leading standards and running seamlessly across various cloud and on\-prem platforms, allowing frictionless and seamless operations of our network and perimeter platforms.


It has a critical role to play as we continue to develop our long\-term multi\-technology and multi\-product network and perimeter capabilities, connecting our asset, sites and people on land and at sea. Delivering best in class software and tooling that not only meet the need of our business today but will be a differentiator, enabling our colleagues and partners with technology solutions that are a catalyst for productivity and innovation.


**Scope**

All data networks provided to Maersk across Core, Edge and Cloud locations (offices, warehouses, terminals, vessels, data centres, cloud etc), and the perimeter services that protect and enable them including but not limited to:


* Wireless Transport: Satellite \| 4G/LTE \| 5G
* IoT Networking Solutions: Industrial Wi\-Fi
* WAN: Internet \| IP/MPLS \| Next\-Gen/SD WAN
* LAN: DC Networking \| SDN \| Fixed \& Wireless
* Perimeter: Load balancers \| NG Firewalls \| Security Service Edge

**Specific Job Requirements**

The role holder shall possess a solid understanding of DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, Jenkins, build pipelines and source control systems and have a working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services: compute, storage, networking, hybrid connectivity, monitoring/logging, security and IAM.


Collaborate with stakeholders and Business Analysts to gather, document and understand requirements. Articulate functional and non\-functional requirements to business and technical stakeholders.


Product mindset and passion about building for internal stakeholders and external customers.


Work with product owners to prioritize features for ongoing sprints and implement features based on service line demand, industry trends, known defects, and issues.


To be a successful technologist at Maersk, you must be passionate about building, enabling and sustaining our business, as well as inspiring and developing our people. Further, in this role you will:


* Be a world class expert in the OSS domain, implementing the defined architectural roadmap for Network tooling for the Maersk Group.
* Support delivery and program management with estimations and planning.
* Validate all the Non\-Functional requirements and provide inputs to the applications team on capacity exercise.
* Practice TDD and follow best practices.
* Produce high\-quality, clean and performant code.
* Implement and publish APIs for ecosystem clients to consume platform services in a consistent way.
* Adopt a product mindset and passion about building for internal and external ecosystem.

What I'll be doing – your accountabilities?


**Software Engineering** – Build and integrate applications in the OSS ecosystem. Engineering of the software tools to drive Fulfilment and Assurance OSS capability to underpin all networking and perimeter services across Core, Edge and Cloud. To be considered for this opportunity the candidate needs to have following technical qualifications:


* Expertise in building/troubleshooting and debugging containerized applications using Kubernetes using microservices concepts like observability and scalability.
* Excellent experience and knowledge of Java 17\+. Well versed with Spring boot.
* TDD with Unit Testing (such as Junit or Mockito) and Integration Testing.
* Strong experience with Python, API development and testing tools such as Postman, and automation scripting, with the ability to develop production\-ready services, integrations and proofs of concept for observability, AIOps and agentic AI use cases.
* Hands\-on experience with microservices, container and cloud technologies, ingress controllers, API gateways, PromQL and LogQL.
* SRE Exposure an advantage. Experience defining service KPIs, SLIs and SLOs using open\-source observability tooling such as Prometheus, Mimir, Grafana, Loki and ELK, together with instrumentation, telemetry and log analytics.
* Knowledge of SQL/NoSQL, Streaming (Kafka) and large\-scale batch processing
* Experience with frontend technologies like react/angular etc. is desirable
* Solid experience in DevOps tooling, GitOps, CI/CD, config management, build pipelines and source control systems
* Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating platforms through webhooks and event\-driven interfaces.
* Experience monitoring application performance, resolving production issues and operating services using SRE practices.
* Comfortable working in agile methodologies (ideally Scrum)

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Everyday Essentials Experiences
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B\+ business and one of the fastest\-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.  

  

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and get more value on every essentials purchase — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.  

  

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off\-the\-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll have the freedom to propose new ideas, prototype them, and ship them worldwide. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.  

  

We're an AI\-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design, build, and own software end to end — working backwards from the customer through design, code, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions to hard problems.
* Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer problems into products that ship worldwide.
* Use AI tools and modern engineering practices to build faster and at a higher bar of quality, and help the team level up how it uses them.
* Own operational excellence for what you build — monitor it, respond when issues arise, and keep improving the customer and partner experience.
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

  

A day in the life  

Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find a better everyday\-essentials product, or fill their basket faster. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.  

  

About the team  

Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, and to help customers find better options along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast\-moving group solving open\-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Senior SCALA Developer
description:
About This Role
**4 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: SCALA**

**Overview**
------------


The client uses the Scala Digital Signage platform in a highly customized manner. While Scala's networking, player\-management, publishing, and status capabilities are generally used as designed, most of the content displayed on screen is generated programmatically. Scala's native content\-authoring tools provide the presentation shell, while custom Python software controls much of the actual content, behavior, event processing, and external\-system interaction.


An engineer supporting this environment must first understand how to design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot an enterprise\-scale digital signage system. This includes recognizing normal production behavior, identifying conditions that require intervention, and diagnosing issues across the signage platform, players, networking, content, data sources, and display hardware.


The engineer must understand Scala Content Manager and its use of FrameSets, Screen Regions, Playlists, Channels, Scheduling, and Content to organize and publish presentations. They must also understand Scala's content\-creation environment, content deployment and troubleshooting, metadata\-driven configuration, and the mechanisms used to execute Python applications within Scala content.


Because the majority of the client's dynamic content is generated programmatically, advanced Python software\-development skills are essential. The current implementation uses an object\-oriented, class\-based architecture designed to support multiple content variations while sharing a common application platform.


A major portion of the environment has been modernized from tightly coupled, content\-specific Python applications into a reusable software architecture. Shared functionality such as event handling, network communication, configuration, logging, data processing, and common runtime services is implemented in reusable Python libraries. Individual signage applications primarily define content\-specific behavior while relying on the shared framework for the underlying infrastructure. This substantially improves maintainability, consistency, reliability, and the ability to develop new signage applications without duplicating large amounts of code.


The environment also requires network\-level Python development, including socket\-based communication used to access the Vision system backend and associated APIs. This role may also involve integrating specialized hardware and device drivers into the Scala environment. Candidates should therefore have experience designing, packaging, deploying, and supporting production Python applications and the tooling and automation required to maintain them.


**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------


* Develop, maintain, and enhance the client's Scala Digital Signage applications and supporting Python software.
* Design and maintain reusable Python libraries and application frameworks used across multiple signage solutions.
* Integrate signage applications with external systems, APIs, data sources, databases, and specialized sensors or hardware.
* Develop and support event\-processing, socket\-based communication, and network\-integration logic.
* Support Scala Content Manager, Scala Player, content deployment, configuration, publishing, and production operations.
* Diagnose production issues across application code, Scala components, players, networking, external data sources, sensors, and display hardware.
* Design new signage solutions while preserving compatibility with the existing client architecture.
* Work directly with client business and technical stakeholders to translate operational requirements into production solutions.
* Provide technical guidance for deployment, troubleshooting, support, and future expansion of the digital signage environment.

**Required Skills**
-------------------


* Strong Python software\-development and software\-architecture experience are essential. Candidates must be capable of designing and maintaining reusable libraries and production applications rather than simply modifying existing scripts.
* Experience with enterprise digital signage, Scala Digital Signage, networked applications, APIs, event\-driven systems, socket programming, hardware integration, distributed\-system troubleshooting, and Windows\-based production environments.
* Because the client's implementation is highly customized, the role requires an engineer capable of understanding and troubleshooting the system as an integrated whole rather than treating Scala, Python, networking, content, player infrastructure, and external systems as separate disciplines.

title: Software Engineer (Python/Wireless)
description:
Meet The Team
  
The Cisco Wireless Feature\& System Engineering team builds end\-to\-end wireless capabilities across access points, controllers, and cloud\-managed platforms. We design features that span device software, control planes, and management systems to deliver seamless, secure, and high\-performance enterprise Wi\-Fi.
  
  

Your Impact
  
A software engineer specializing in wireless technology at Cisco is responsible for driving the design, implementation, and optimization of wireless solutions for customer projects and accounts. This role requires a deep understanding of current and emerging wireless standards, including Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability), 802\.1X security types, and Layer 2 protocols. The engineer will leverage AI/ML knowledge to uplift test automation, develop new test plans, and build productivity\-enhancing tools, ensuring superior wireless network reliability, latency, performance, and customer outcomes.
  
  

**In this role:**  

* Lead technology design, planning, and deployment of wireless solutions, including small to mid\-size or moderately complex systems, ensuring reliability, availability, latency, resilience, and performance targets are met across current\-generation and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 environments.
* Collaborate with customers to plan, design, configure, and validate Cisco wireless technologies, including Wi\-Fi standards through Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn), Layer 2 protocols, WLAN technologies, and 802\.1X security types.
* Write new test automation scripts and uplift existing test scripts using Python to enhance wireless technology testing frameworks and improve automation efficiency.
* Utilize AI/ML techniques to uplift test automation frameworks, develop new test plans tailored to wireless and Wi\-Fi 8 reliability requirements, and build tools that improve productivity and streamline testing and deployment processes.
* Assist with integration and implementation of tools, systems, and service assurance related to wireless networks, including continuous monitoring, telemetry analysis, and alerting in test and production environments for latency, packet loss, roaming, interference, and reliability conditions.
* Support presales by translating business requirements into technical wireless solution designs and creating customer collateral, documentation, and knowledge transfer materials.
* Drive customer technology transitions and influence solution architectures and services in wireless networking, including readiness planning for Wi\-Fi 8 and Ultra High Reliability capabilities.
* Comply with company policies and utilize relevant tools to support Professional Services strategies and goals.
* Act as an individual contributor and mentor within the team, providing guidance and support to peers and engineering interns.
* Lead corrective actions, including root cause analysis and process improvements on escaped defects for specific product features.
* Implement automation frameworks and execute test cases and plans for projects with multiple features, including Wi\-Fi 8 functional, interoperability, performance, reliability, and regression validation.
* Report issues and findings with root cause analysis and potential software solutions; advocate for quality improvements and strategic changes.
* Oversee creation and storage of test plans and documentation; translate dashboard metrics into consumable documentation such as release notes, bug reports, and test results.
* Collaborate with other engineering groups to document test cases and apply best practices for document review.
* Develop productive working relationships with peer stakeholders within and across teams.
* Work independently with guidance from leadership to determine the best approach to accomplish work and act as a resource for less experienced colleagues.


**Minimum Qualifications:**  

* Deep domain\-based engineering and configuration knowledge of Cisco wireless technologies, with knowledge of current Wi\-Fi generations and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn) concepts.
* Working knowledge of Wi\-Fi standards, including Ultra High Reliability objectives, deterministic and tail\-latency behavior, packet\-loss reduction, roaming continuity, overlapping\-BSS performance, multi\-AP coordination concepts, coexistence, and backward compatibility.
* Strong expertise in AI/ML applications for test automation and productivity improvements.
* Experience in writing comprehensive test plans and building automation tools for wireless functional, interoperability, roaming, latency, packet\-loss, reliability, and performance validation.
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills specific to wireless networks, including interference, congestion, roaming, latency, packet loss, and multi\-AP deployment scenarios.
* Excellent communication and customer engagement abilities.
* Experience in solution design activities.
* Ability to create and deliver technical documentation and training materials.


**Key technologies:**  

* Wi\-Fi Standards: Knowledge of Wi\-Fi generations, including Wi\-Fi 6/6E, Wi\-Fi 7, and emerging Wi\-Fi 8 (IEEE 802\.11bn / Ultra High Reliability). Understanding the evolution of these standards and their security, reliability, latency, power\-efficiency, coexistence, and performance objectives is essential.
* Wi\-Fi 8 / IEEE 802\.11bn: Familiarity with the emerging Ultra High Reliability amendment and its focus on WLAN reliability, latency, throughput, roaming continuity, power efficiency, peer\-to\-peer operation, coexistence, and overlapping\-BSS performance.
* Layer 2 Protocols: Familiarity with Layer 2 security policies such as WLAN, Static WEP, WPA/WPA2, WPA3, and especially 802\.1X authentication. Knowledge of encryption types like TKIP, AES, CCMP, and GCMP is important.
* WLAN Technologies: Expertise in Cisco wireless solutions, including configuration of WLAN security, use of Cisco Wireless LAN Controllers, and deployment of secure WLANs with features such as Fast Secure Roaming (802\.11r), AAA integration with RADIUS and Cisco ISE, multi\-AP architectures, and telemetry\-driven assurance. Familiarity with Wi\-Fi 8 goals for improved reliability, latency, roaming resilience, and operation across overlapping BSS environments is desirable.
* 802\.1X Security Types: Deep understanding of 802\.1X authentication mechanisms including EAP types such as PEAP, EAP\-TLS, LEAP, and EAP\-FAST. Knowledge of how 802\.1X integrates with AAA servers (e.g., Cisco ISE) for centralized policy management, and how it supports secure network access and segmentation.
* Python programming for developing and uplifting test automation scripts, enhancing wireless technology testing frameworks and productivity.
* AI/ML Knowledge: Proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve wireless performance and operational efficiency. The role includes uplifting test automation, generating wireless test plans, building productivity tools, and validating Wi\-Fi 8 reliability objectives.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. title: Software engineer - Python Validation
description:
**Company Description**  

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.


Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.


Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

 **Job Description**  

Join SanDisk's Storage Validation Engineering team and help deliver high\-quality software solutions for validating next\-generation flash storage products.


In this role, you will develop AI\-assisted Python automation solutions, analyze product and protocol requirements, execute validation on storage devices, investigate complex failures, and contribute to release qualification. You will work closely with software, firmware, validation, and release teams across India, Israel, and the United States.


This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy Python development, AI\-assisted engineering, system\-level debugging, Linux and Windows environments, and working close to hardware.


Responsibilities

* Understand product requirements, technical designs, and storage protocol specifications.
* Create comprehensive validation strategies including functional, negative, integration, stress, recovery, and regression scenarios.
* Plan, design, develop, review, and maintain automated validation solutions using Python and AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Validate storage features, software enhancements, and bug fixes on physical storage devices.
* Execute sanity, functional, integration, performance, and regression test campaigns.
* Analyze logs, reproduce failures, and isolate issues across test frameworks, host software, firmware, operating systems, and device layers.
* Report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, configurations, and technical findings.
* Verify fixes and provide evidence\-based quality sign\-off.
* Contribute qualified tests to automated sanity and regression suites.
* Collaborate with globally distributed development, validation, and release teams.
* Improve test automation, diagnostics, reliability, and engineering productivity.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly for test design, coding, debugging, data analysis, and documentation activities.

  

**Qualifications**  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in software engineering, validation, system testing, quality assurance, or test automation.
* Strong programming skills in Python with hands\-on experience developing automated test solutions.
* Experience developing, debugging, and maintaining automated test frameworks.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, defect lifecycle management, and quality engineering practices.
* Experience working in Linux and Windows environments.
* Working knowledge of Git and GitHub development workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, drive tasks to completion, and take ownership of validation activities.


Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with SSDs, flash storage, firmware, drivers, embedded systems, or system software.
* Knowledge of storage protocols such as NVMe, SCSI, or ATA.
* Experience with Python test frameworks, log analysis, and data\-driven testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with GitHub, Jira, Agile, Scrum, and Continuous Integration workflows.
* Working knowledge of C or C\+\+.
* Exposure to large\-scale automation environments and test infrastructure development.
* Experience using AI tools to improve software development, testing, or engineering productivity.


What We Look For

* Strong problem\-solving and debugging abilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to product quality.
* Curiosity to understand complex interactions between software, firmware, operating systems, and hardware.
* Ownership mindset from requirement analysis through validation sign\-off.
* Proactive mindset with a high level of accountability.
* Assertive communicator who can clearly and confidently express technical viewpoints while respecting others.
* Ability to challenge assumptions and make data\-driven decisions.
* Continuous learning attitude with interest in automation, AI\-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies.
* Strong collaboration skills across globally distributed teams.
* Confidence to take initiative, drive improvements, and deliver results

  

**Additional Information**  

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.


Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us atjobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Senior Software Technical Leader
description:

* Build management of tasks from various developers using software configuration and change management tools such as JIRA, Polarion, BitBucket and Gitlab.

* Solid Hands\-on experience in Vector DaVinci tool chain, EBTresos and ETAS ISOLAR
* Must have experienced with 32bit Infineon TC 3xx microcontroller
* Exemplary expertise in Embedded SW development using C language, debugging for embedded multithreaded and multi core/CPU software environment.
* Strong ability to comprehend microcontroller hardware and associated schematics
* Experience in configuration \& Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, BitBucket, Gitlab, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/VectorCAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/NeoVI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking.

	* Deep expertise in more than two AUTOSAR BSW stack/MCAL modules\- com stack(CAN, Ethernet),Memory Stack, Diagnostic Stack, Cybersecurity Stack ,OS, Watchdog ,MCAL

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Purchase Experience team is seeking a full stack software development engineer with a passion for engineering excellence. We offer you the opportunity to deliver and lead high visibility \& high\-impact innovation for customers across the Cart application services in Amazon. We extend to you the opportunity to develop upon multi\-tiered, low\-latency, highly resilient distributed systems on a grand scale. You will play a pivotal role in crafting solutions that profoundly enhance the shopping experience, handling vast data volumes, delivering lightning\-fast response times, and simplifying the cart process to a remarkable degree. You must understand the importance of quality and testability in regards to the long term health and operational excellence of the Amazon eco system and you will be expected to drive improvements to current and future systems in these areas. You will contribute to both funcational and non\-functional aspects of the application in the form of enhacing customer experience, improving latency, performance, and business investigations. You will learn and grow by working closely with senior engineers across our organisation.  

  

The ideal candidate will have excellent technical design, problem solving, Computer Science fundamentals, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable interacting with technical and non\-technical stakeholders at all levels. The ability to work backwards and think from a customer perspective is crucial as the ideal candidate is expected to contribute to the product vision in addition to the technical design and implementation.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop full\-stack solutions for Post Add to Cart and Cart services, considering scalability, performance, and reliability across multi\-tiered distributed systems
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product, design, and operations to understand customer needs and translate them into technical implementations
* Investigate and optimize system performance, latency, and resource utilization through data\-driven analysis and experimentation
* Contribute to code quality and system testability by establishing best practices, conducting thorough code reviews, and identifying areas for improvement
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and participate actively in design and architecture discussions

  

A day in the life  

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll work on full\-stack solutions that handle massive transaction volumes while maintaining lightning\-fast response times. Your day might include collaborating with product and design partners to understand customer pain points in the post add to cart experiences, writing and reviewing code for distributed systems that process millions of requests, investigating performance bottlenecks to optimize latency, and participating in design discussions with engineers across our organization. You'll balance building new features with strengthening the foundational systems that keep our services reliable and resilient. Beyond coding, you'll contribute to our culture of operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve system quality, testability, and long\-term health.  

  

About the team  

We're a collaborative group of engineers passionate about delivering seamless post add to cart and cart experiences for Amazon customers worldwide. Our team focuses on building the infrastructure and services that make purchasing simple and dependable, even during peak shopping periods. We work closely with engineers at all levels across the organization, learning from one another and sharing knowledge to solve complex distributed systems challenges. Together, we're committed to continuously improving how customers interact with our platform, and we're excited to have someone join us who thinks deeply about both technical excellence and customer impact.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
