title: Staff Software Engineer - Travel
description:
**About Rippling**


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.


Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

 **About the role**  

You’ll be part of the Travel integrations team, helping to define the future of corporate travel through the Rippling Platform’s integrated solutions. As part of Rippling’s Spend Suite—which also includes corporate cards, expense management, procurement, and bill pay—the Travel team is integral to our all\-in\-one solution for managing corporate spending.

  

Our customers value the seamless integration of corporate cards, expense management, and accounting automation, with travel management as the next frontier. Our mission is to build the best travel management platform for employees, finance teams, and travel managers alike.

 **What you will do:**

* Craft exceptional platform solutions that will benefit multiple teams to create a seamless user experience.
* Be hands\-on in technical architecture and be the liaison between between product leadership, engineering leadership, and technical workstreams
* Tackle complex engineering challenges, leveraging your expertise to devise ingenious solutions that push the boundaries of what is possible.
* Assume clear ownership of your projects, empowering you to make impactful decisions and drive their successful implementation.
* Play a pivotal role in leading and mentoring highly talented engineers across Travel Org.
* Immerse yourself in one of Rippling's newest and most influential products, becoming a true authority and contributing to its ongoing development.

 **What you will need:**

* **Experience**: 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong track record in backend development and distributed systems.
* **Architecture**: Proven ability to design large\-scale, fault\-tolerant systems from scratch. You understand the trade\-offs between consistency and availability and know when "eventual consistency" is not enough.
* **High Agency**: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't wait for a ticket to be assigned; you identify the business problem, scope the technical solution, and execute.
* **Domain Agility**: You have the intellectual curiosity to master the complex domain of treasury and money movement in a matter of days, even if you don't have a background in it.
* **Tech Stack**: Deep proficiency in a modern backend language (Python, Go, Java, etc.) plus experience with complex data modeling (SQL/NoSQL)
* **Communication:** Ability to convey technical concepts to both engineering and non\-engineering audiences effectively.

title: Software Engineer 2
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Full Stack AI Engineer
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

JLL REMS (Real Estate Management Services) is building next\-generation AI\-powered solutions to transform how our clients interact with and derive insights from property management data. We are seeking a talented Full Stack AI Engineer who combines deep AI expertise with full\-stack development capabilities to join our team.
  
As a Full Stack AI Engineer, you will design, develop, and deploy end\-to\-end GenAI solutions that enable users to retrieve knowledge, analyze information through intuitive interfaces. You will be responsible for building intelligent backend systems that translate natural language into actionable queries, as well as creating user\-facing interfaces that deliver AI\-powered insights, filtered dashboards, and summaries in multiple languages.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**AI development:**  

Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art GenAI\-based solutions for property management applications.
  
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines using LLMs to efficiently utilize property management data from data warehouses and semantic indexes.
  
Implement AI based techniques to extract valuable insights and patterns from data, enabling actionable recommendations and predictions.
  
Design and develop agentic AI systems and implement Model Context Protocols (MCPs) for enhanced AI capabilities.
  
Develop and fine\-tune GenAI wirkflows for complex decision\-making scenarios.
  
  

**Full Stack Development:**  

Develop and implement robust web applications using React, Python, Django, and the Django REST Framework.
  
Design and develop efficient, scalable backend applications and APIs that integrate seamlessly with AI models.
  
Create responsive and intuitive front\-end interfaces using React / NextJS, HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript.
  
Implement secure coding practices and adhere to industry best practices across the full stack.
  
  

**Cloud Infrastructure \& DevOps:**  

Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform for scalable cloud deployments.
  
Deploy and manage AI services on cloud platforms, including Azure Search Service and OpenSearch.
  
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and other automation tools.
  
Ensure scalability, performance, and reliability through regular testing, debugging, and optimization.
  
Implement containerization using Docker and orchestration for microservices architectures.
  
  

**Collaboration \& Delivery:**  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including BI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders, to gather requirements and define project scope.
  
Translate business requirements into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  
Provide technical guidance and support to teams in integrating and utilizing AI\-powered solutions effectively.
  
Conduct code reviews and address bugs, performance issues, and technical debt.
  
Work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment to ensure timely and successful delivery.
  
  

**Continuous Innovation:**  

Keep up to date with the latest advancements in GenAI technologies, LLMs, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Continuously improve software development processes and practices.
  
Stay current with emerging cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and full\-stack development trends.
  
  

**To apply you need to be:**  

Experience \& Education
  
  

**Required:**  

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or a related field.
  
3\+ years of proven experience as an AI Engineer, Full Stack Developer, or similar role.
  
Strong proficiency in Python and relevant AI libraries and frameworks (LangChain, Langgraph etc.).
  
Demonstrated experience developing GenAI\-based solutions and tools using LLMs.
  
In\-depth knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, including language models, RAG pipelines, and text generation algorithms.
  
Strong proficiency in full\-stack development with React / NextJS, Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
  
**Experience with front\-end technologies:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern React patterns.
  
Strong knowledge of SQL and database technologies (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  
Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  
Hands\-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  
Experience with cloud computing platforms (AWS or Azure) and their AI services.
  
Familiarity with Azure Search Service and/or OpenSearch for semantic search implementations.
  
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and distributed computing architectures.
  
Experience working with large\-scale datasets and implementing data processing pipelines.
  
Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, and best practices.
  
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and software development lifecycle.
  
  

**Preferred:**  

Experience developing agentic AI systems and implementing Model Context Protocols (MCPs).
  
Familiarity with vector databases and semantic indexing technologies.
  
Experience with API gateway design and microservices architectures.
  
Knowledge of security best practices for AI systems and data privacy compliance.
  
Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization tools like DataDog.
  
Skills \& Competencies
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, and innovative environment.
  
Excellent problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  
Self\-starter with the ability to quickly learn, adapt, and conduct POCs as the GenAI landscape evolves.
  
Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for non\-technical stakeholders.
  
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
  
Passion for learning and staying updated with rapidly evolving AI technologies and industry trends.
  
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  
  

**What's in it for you:**  

The opportunity to work at a rapid\-growth company and industry leader in commercial real estate services.
  
Flexible, high\-energy work environment and culture that encourages innovation.
  
Work on cutting\-edge GenAI technologies and shape the future of property management solutions.
  
Collaborative team environment with opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  
Exposure to the latest advancements in AI, cloud infrastructure, and full\-stack development.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**Data \& Integrations Team \| Navan**



Navan has transformed the corporate travel, payment, and expense landscape by consistently prioritizing user needs. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the **Enterprise Team**, you will be a technical leader building the backbone of our corporate travel infrastructure. You will architect and develop the critical systems that allow the world's largest companies to configure, manage, and scale their travel programs—covering everything from complex policy engines and approval workflows to user lifecycle management and enterprise analytics.



This is a high\-impact engineering role where you will solve complex logic and scalability challenges. You will ensure that our platform can handle sophisticated corporate rules and seamless integrations for massive global organizations. You'll collaborate closely with a talented team of engineers, product managers, and architects to design and build innovative solutions that empower our customers to manage their travel spend effectively.


**What You'll Do**


* **Architect Enterprise Core Services:** Design, build, and evolve the backend microservices that power the "brain" of the corporate travel platform—specifically the engines responsible for travel policies, dynamic approval workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* **Build Data\-Driven Services:** Design and develop highly scalable APIs and data processing services that manage high volumes of data, power reporting features, and enable seamless integrations with both internal and external systems.
* **Own Systems End\-to\-End:** Take technical ownership of a problem domain, architecting, developing, and launching key backend features and microservices that have a direct impact on our users and business operations.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Work cross\-functionally with various engineering, product, and business teams to deliver complex, cross\-domain features in a collaborative, global environment.
* **Drive the Technical Vision:** Partner with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the long\-term technical roadmap for our data platform. Be a subject matter expert on backend architecture, distributed systems, and data integration patterns.
* **Champion Best Practices:** Contribute to a culture of technical excellence by writing high\-quality, scalable, and well\-tested code. Mentor other engineers on backend development and advocate for best practices in system design, API development, monitoring, and operational reliability.


**What We're Looking For**


* 4\+ years of experience in backend software development, building large\-scale distributed systems for SaaS products or consumer\-facing applications in a fast\-paced environment.
* Deep expertise in backend development using **Java and Spring Boot**, with a strong grasp of JVM fundamentals, performance tuning, and concurrency.
* Proven experience with databases (**SQL and/or NoSQL**), complex data modeling, and query optimization to handle large datasets.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable, resilient applications using **microservices, distributed systems, and event\-driven architectures** on cloud platforms (**AWS** preferred).
* Demonstrates strong technical ownership and a collaborative mindset, with excellent communication skills and a proven ability to ship production\-quality services equipped with robust testing, monitoring, and documentation.
* A passion for investigating and solving challenging problems in system scalability and data integrity, with a willingness to learn and utilize new tools and technologies.
* Ability to effectively leverage AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, CodeGPT, Claude, and Cursor) to accelerate development and innovate on engineering workflows while maintaining high standards for code quality.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent hands\-on experience.


**Bonus Points For**


* Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly in building backend systems to support agentic AI, LLM\-based features, or autonomous workflows.
* Deep familiarity with data pipelines (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis), ETL processes, and reporting systems.
* Experience with performance and scalability testing for high\-throughput services.
* Familiarity with travel industry concepts (e.g., bookings, inventory, integrations with GDS or other suppliers).

  


Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers.


**Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application.


* **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Meet The Team
  
  

The Cisco Intersight team is at the forefront of Cisco’s AI Infrastructure strategy, serving as the intelligent management platform that orchestrates and simplifies complex hybrid cloud environments. We provide the control plane that enables organizations to deploy, monitor, and optimize AI\-driven workloads across distributed infrastructure, playing a critical role in the broader Cisco AI story. Our team is a high\-performing, collaborative group of engineers who thrive on solving complex distributed systems challenges in a fast\-paced environment. We pride ourselves on a culture of technical excellence and innovation, where every team member is empowered to influence the future of cloud management. What makes us truly exciting is our mission to build the"brai" of the modern data center, enabling seamless AI operations at scale.
  
  

Your Impact
  
  

A successful candidate will have deep technical and software expertise in cloud\-native technologies and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, startup\-like environment to deliver seamless, scalable solutions with broad business impact.
  
  

We seek individuals driven by the challenge of solving unique technical problems, who thrive with creative freedom, and are eager to explore new territories and learn. You care about your work and its impact.
  
  

You will develop and validate infrastructure, software components, and integrations in on\-prem and cloud environments. You should have a good sense of product design, passion for quality and customers, and willingness to work in small, self\-organizing teams are essential. If you want to excel in a fast\-paced environment creating and shaping the future of AI infrastructure, this job is for you!
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's in Computer Science (or equivalent) with 5 years or Master's with 3 years or PhD with 0 year of related experience.
* Experience programming with Go, C/C\+\+, Java and/or Python
* Experience with microservices software architecture and large\-scale distributed systems
* Experience with data structures, algorithms, and software design
* Experience working with cloud technologies like Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud
* Good understanding of Linux, OS and networking fundamentals.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Software and product development experience with cloud computing and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience withcontainerizationand orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with virtualization environments such as vSphere, HyperV, KVM.
* Deep understanding of AI technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to effectively leverage them to improve engineering productivity, solution design, and problem\-solving.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5\.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  

If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Staff UI Software Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Get to know Okta**



Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.



At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box \- we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.



Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.


**Access Essentials \- Core Product**



The Access Essentials organization at Okta builds the platform features for authentication and authorization across Okta\-protected resources. Our mission is to enable customers to access these resources seamlessly \& securely. We develop Okta cloud services and client software that allow users to seamlessly login to devices and use Okta authenticators to access applications securely. The Access Management team is part of Okta R\&D Engineering. Learn more about Okta’s Engineering on our blog.x


**The First** **Party Apps Platform team**



First Party Apps Platform team is part of the larger Access Essential \- Core Product organization. We develop Okta’s secure web experiences for end\-user authentication and access. Our products and features are high\-impact and high\-visibility. Our team develops the Okta Sign\-in Widget, End User SSO Dashboard, and the Okta Browser Plugin.


**The Engineer Opportunity**



We seek an experienced web front\-end engineer to join our First Party Apps Platform team. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in web development, building well\-tested and maintainable software. The opportunity is an excellent chance to build software with high impact and usage. If you’re excited to work on something that millions of users will use on a daily basis, this is the opportunity for you.


**Job Duties and Responsibilities****:**


* Lead the design and development of complex, high\-performance features using React and TypeScript.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, UI/UX designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into robust and effective frontend solutions.
* Write clean, modular, well\-tested, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.
* Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and responsiveness across various devices and browsers.
* Contribute to the evolution of our frontend architecture, ensuring its long\-term scalability and maintainability.
* Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring code quality across the team.
* Proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and areas for improvement.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest trends and technologies in frontend development, evaluating and recommending new tools and approaches.
* Champion a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and technical excellence within the team.

**Minimum Requirements****:**


* 5\+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with a strong focus on building complex web applications.
* Deep expertise in React, including a strong understanding of its core principles, hooks, component lifecycle, and state management.
* Proficiency in TypeScript, with a proven ability to leverage its features for robust and maintainable codebases.
* Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience with front\-end tooling such as Webpack, Babel, Vite, and package managers (Yarn).
* Demonstrated experience consuming and integrating with RESTful APIs.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright) and a commitment to writing comprehensive tests.
* Strong understanding of version control systems, particularly Git.
* Experience with responsive design principles and building accessible web interfaces.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, with the ability to debug complex issues and find practical solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a cross\-functional team.

**Nice to have****:**


* Familiarity with design systems and component libraries.
* An understanding of Identity and Access Management protocols and architecture, e.g., FIDO, U2F, WebAuth, SSO, SAML, OAuth, Federation.
* Contributions to open\-source projects.

**Education and Training:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 2\-3 years of experience working on large\-scale enterprise grade software
